name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor
description: Ultrasonic ranger. 5 V part with a 5 V echo output: put a divider between ECHO and the controller.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: 10 us high pulse starts a measurement.

pins.name: ECHO
pins.description: High for the round-trip time: us / 58 = cm.

notes: Published: 4.5-5.5 V; 15 mA working (20 mA max); range 2 cm to 4 m; measuring angle 15 deg; 10 us trigger; echo high at 5 V; 3 mm resolution; at least 60 ms between measurements (16 Hz); 45 x 20 x 15 mm. noiseSigmaPct 0.5 is an estimate from the 3 mm resolution. Mass 8.5 g is a retailer figure (not published).
